purpose: Test an explicit, user-provided tomato option after the scratch specialists lost master accuracy. Preserve automatic 177-label scoring and compare the same fractions for the matched no-field control.
sample_support: All ten tomato conditions eligible. Checkpoint and policy screening uses only master, Pakistan and Sheikh validation. Macro-F1 on each field source averages represented labels. Banu is diagnostic. Passing only licenses a frozen independent confirmation.
selection: A fraction must satisfy master and source guards on each seed, improve versus the same-fraction matched arm on both seeds, and pass mean gain thresholds. Take highest mean source gain, breaking ties for smaller fractions. Freeze the seed with higher mean field F1, breaking a tie for lower seed.
confirmation: Evaluate the frozen treatment and incumbent with tomato supplied on PlantCity tomato labels once. Require 0.03 or greater macro-F1 improvement, accuracy loss at most 0.01, and late/early/healthy recall loss no greater than 0.05 each. Report joint automatic scope separately. No threshold fitting on the confirmation source.
